verdict.rationale: Cekura is a SaaS testing and observability platform, not itself an agent, so the official MCP server axis applies. Its docs describe installing Cekura Skills and MCP so AI assistants can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations, with MCP config bundled in a plugin that works with Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and others. missing for 10: a documented list of MCP tools and resources with transport/auth details, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Install Cekura Skills and MCP so your AI assistant can design, run, and improve voice-agent evaluations.
The plugin bundles Skills, slash commands, and MCP config in one install.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.cekura.ai/mcp/overview
Whether you're using Claude Code, Cursor, or VS Code, you can manage your voice agent testing and observability directly from your development environment.
